Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses a trifunctional lipid probe for photo-crosslinking and click-chemistry based enrichment of binding proteins (affinity purification). Quantification is performed via spectral counting (LFQ). While the probe targets PIP3, the proteomics workflow is a standard AP-MS approach.

scope: we attached biotin to the lipid and lipid-protein conjugates were isolated with streptavidine beads, washed and subjected to proteomic analysis.

The cytoplasmic and total membrane fraction (resuspended in PBS:0.5% Triton X-100) for each sample were incubated with 200 µl prewashed picolyl-azide agarose beads (Click Chemistry Tools, Cat No 1235, Component A) in presence of 1 mM final CuSO4, 100 µM BTTAA or TBTA and 1 mM sodium ascorbate to catalyze the click reaction (RT for 1 h agitating).
subcellular_fraction: Cells were fractionated into membrane and cytosolic fractions.
Cells fractions were then isolated using the MinElute plasma membrane protein isolation kit (Invent Biotechnologies, Cat No SM-005).
Hit proteins were only found in the membrane fraction.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was performed on proteins affinity-captured via click chemistry using azide beads after cellular fractionation into membrane and cytosolic fractions. Only the membrane fraction yielded hits.
